svg.title: Plate II-04.1. Candidate and validated discovery
svg.desc: Five kinds of claim the record can yield, then three candidates generated from existing information (baricitinib, fish oil for Raynaud's, Co-Scientist proposals) shown beside the test each one met and the narrower claim each test supports.
